definition: Shogun is a free, open-source machine learning software library written in C++.
details: It offers numerous algorithms and data structures for machine learning problems. It offers interfaces for Octave, Python, R, Java, Lua, Ruby and C# using SWIG. It is licensed under the terms of the GNU General Public License version 3 or later.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. That is Shogun (toolbox) — a small key that opens a big door.
